scope: Derived path-tokenized view, not original frozen plan bytes or an executable replay configuration.

pathTokens.${ARTIFACT_ROOT}: Original frozen diagnostic artifact cache root; original identities and hashes are retained.
pathTokens.${QRGEN_CHECKOUT}: Existing SDK checkout/dependencies used by the original artifact-only study.

plan.scope: Read-only physical-symbol conflict feasibility; no decoder policy/filter, build, repository, or remote mutation.
plan.motivation: Known /1/35 conflict; not a held-out or blinded case. Existing reports/photographs were seen before this protocol. No payload or expected-truth field may enter geometry extraction, pair measurement, or control placement.

measurementPlan.frozenProfiles: Existing baseline EAN13 hard, max255, minLineCount2, Ignore addons, downscale=false; original35, derived35, original07 and actualChrome07. Also summarize geometry collisions across all 479 frozen rasters under this same profile.
measurementPlan.resultGeometry: Use normalized returned positions only. Symbol axis is midpoint(topRight,bottomRight)-midpoint(topLeft,bottomLeft); compute axis-aligned projections on dominant image axis, perpendicular support extents, pair projected intersection/union, exact orientation agreement, and perpendicular gap. Geometry functions cannot read text, bytes, truth, validity or lineCount.
measurementPlan.candidatePairDefinition: Descriptive projection-only relation: same dominant axis and projected intervals have positive intersection. This deliberately overbroad relation is tested for false grouping; it is not a physical-symbol classifier.
measurementPlan.connectedInkQuestion: Existing output geometry and accepted-row traces do not expose a verified complete physical bar support mask. Photographs may be inspected to assess this information gap; no thresholded component segmentation or hand-picked crop is proposed as evidence.
measurementPlan.rowTrace: Summarize accepted-row extents/coordinates for all returned groups of the four focus rasters. Do not treat source-port max1/max2 as actual-engine scheduling evidence.

generator.placement: 20px outer white padding. Two-symbol controls copy exact opaque PNGs; perpendicular gap is between complete PNGs, including their existing quiet padding. Half-span offset is floor(PNG width/2). White-band controls overwrite central 4/16 complete raster rows with opaque white. Rotate90 is an exact nearest-neighbor pixel permutation of the complete composite.

decisionRules: A projection-only pair relation that groups a two-symbol control fails as a safe physical-symbol identity rule. Do not tune an overlap/gap/support threshold after seeing failures.
No majority/support winner or known-truth replacement may be selected. Retain contradictory values and mark the inference undecided.
No physical identity conclusion follows solely from two disjoint output strips with shared projected span. Document instrumentation needed to distinguish one distorted symbol from two real codes.
Any recommended next experiment must freeze geometry and analysis criteria before truth review on new controls/held-out images.
limitations: Known selected development cases and generated controls; no population accuracy or Scandit comparison.
Returned boxes are accepted-scanline envelopes, not complete physical barcode boundaries.
Early exit/downscale/inversion can change scheduling. Existing actual paired max1/2 records provide outputs but no complete attempted-row trace.
Photograph inspection is qualitative and cannot justify production thresholds.
